product_overview: Internal web dashboard that ingests public Google Sheets, computes marketing & CS KPIs, stores/cache data in SQLite, and provides AI-driven analysis and chat via multiple provider fallbacks.
core_goals: Allow teams to fetch and cache Google Sheets data for offline analysis and KPI calculation.
Provide AI-powered business analysis and chat with provider fallback and health routing.
Offer CRUD management for bookmarks, cached sheets, meetings, monthly sales, retur records, and app settings.
Generate and manage business alerts with deduplication and configurable thresholds.
Support backup and restore of the local SQLite database (export/import) and batch CSV import for retur data.

features.name: Google Sheet Proxy
features.description: Fetch a public Google Sheets CSV via proxy and return CSV content for parsing.
user_flows: GET /api/sheet?url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/ID/export?format=csv -> Receive 200 text/csv with CSV content
GET /api/sheet -> Receive 400 with { error: 'URL diperlukan' }
GET /api/sheet?url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/INVALID/export?format=csv -> Receive 400 with error message when sheet returns non-200
GET /api/sheet?url=https://internal-service.local/secret -> Receive 500 if fetch fails (network/timeout)

features.name: AI Business Analysis
features.description: Submit dashboard summary and raw data to AI to receive quick structured insights or raw analysis text with provider metadata.
user_flows: POST /api/analyze with body { bulan: 'Mei 2026', summary: {...}, rawData: [...], csData: [...], advData: [...], advSpend: [...], kpiBenchmarks: [...], csDaily: [...], dashboardCS: [...], growth: [...], errorReport: 'Tidak ada' } -> Receive 200 { quick: { ... }, analysis: null, provider: 'gemini' }
POST /api/analyze with body that causes AI to return non-JSON -> Receive 200 { quick: null, analysis: 'raw text analysis', provider: 'claude' }
POST /api/analyze with malformed body (missing required data) -> Receive 500 with error message when analysis fails

features.name: AI Smart Router
features.description: Route AI tasks to the healthiest available provider with automatic fallback and provide provider health status.
user_flows: POST /api/router with body { task: 'summarize', payload: { text: '...' } } -> Receive 200 with AI provider result (result body and provider name)
POST /api/router with body { preferredProvider: 'gemini', task: 'briefing', payload: {...} } -> Receive 200 with provider result if preferred is available
POST /api/router with body { payload: {...} } (missing task) -> Receive 400 with { error: 'task and payload are required' }
GET /api/router -> Receive 200 with { health: { gemini: 'ok'|'down', claude: 'ok'|'down', kimi: 'ok'|'down' } }

features.name: Semantic Sheet Mapper
features.description: Send sheet headers and sample rows to AI to produce a semantic schema mapping for downstream parsing and visualization.
user_flows: POST /api/semantic-map with body { sheetName: 'Data Ads', headers: ['Tanggal','Lead','Spend'], sampleRows: [ ['01/05/2026','50','100000'] ] } -> Receive 200 semantic schema object
POST /api/semantic-map with body { headers: [], sampleRows: [] } (missing sheetName) -> Receive 400 with { error: 'sheetName and headers required' }
POST /api/semantic-map with valid body but AI provider fails -> Receive 500 with error message

features.name: Entity Drill-Down Analysis
features.description: Perform a detailed analysis on a specific entity (e.g., a CS person or advertiser) across available sheets.
user_flows: POST /api/drill-down with body { entityType: 'adv', entityName: 'Campaign A', availableSheets: ['ads','spend','orders'] } -> Receive 200 drill-down result object
POST /api/drill-down with body missing entityName -> Receive 400 with { error: 'entityType, entityName, and availableSheets required' }
POST /api/drill-down with body valid but processing fails -> Receive 500 with error message

features.name: Bookmarks Management
features.description: Create, update, list, and delete bookmarked Google Spreadsheets and their sheet maps.
user_flows: POST /api/db/bookmarks with body { label: 'Mei 2026', spreadsheetId: '1BxiM...upms', sheetMap: { ads: 'Data Ads' } } -> Receive 200 BookmarkedSheet (upsert result)
POST /api/db/bookmarks with same spreadsheetId and new label -> Receive 200 BookmarkedSheet updated
GET /api/db/bookmarks -> Receive 200 array of BookmarkedSheet objects (includes newly created bookmark)
DELETE /api/db/bookmarks?id=bookmark-id -> Receive 200 { success: true }
DELETE /api/db/bookmarks -> Receive 400 with { error: 'ID required' }

features.name: Sheet Cache Management
features.description: Store and retrieve cached sheet extracts per bookmark and sheet type for offline access.
user_flows: POST /api/db/cache with body { bookmarkId: 'bk-123', sheetName: 'Data Ads', sheetType: 'ads', data: [ { Tanggal: '01/05/2026', Lead: '50' } ] } -> Receive 200 CachedSheetData (created or replaced)
GET /api/db/cache?bookmarkId=bk-123 -> Receive 200 array of CachedSheetData for the bookmark
GET /api/db/cache -> Receive 200 [] or full list if bookmarkId absent (endpoint accepts bookmarkId query param)
POST /api/db/cache with missing bookmarkId -> Receive 400 with error (invalid request body)

features.name: Monthly Sales Records
features.description: Create, read, and delete monthly sales summary records used for trend and KPI calculations.
user_flows: POST /api/db/monthly-sales with body { monthYear: '2026-05', totalRevenue: 500000000, totalOrders: 1200, totalAdSpend: 150000000, roas: 3.33, notes: 'Mei performance' } -> Receive 200 MonthlySales (created/updated)
GET /api/db/monthly-sales?monthYear=2026-05 -> Receive 200 MonthlySales object or array filtered by monthYear
DELETE /api/db/monthly-sales?id=monthly-sales-id -> Receive 200 { success: true }
DELETE /api/db/monthly-sales -> Receive 400 with { error: 'ID required' }

features.name: Meeting Notes
features.description: Store and retrieve meeting notes with optional filtering by type and month.
user_flows: POST /api/db/meetings with body { date: '2026-05-10', type: 'review', title: 'Review Performa Iklan Mei', attendees: 'Team X', agenda: 'ROAS, optimasi', decisions: 'Increase budget', actionItems: 'Adjust bids', notes: '...' } -> Receive 200 MeetingNote (created or updated if id provided)
GET /api/db/meetings?type=review&month=2026-05 -> Receive 200 array of MeetingNote filtered by type and month
DELETE /api/db/meetings?id=meeting-id -> Receive 200 { success: true }
DELETE /api/db/meetings -> Receive 400 with { error: 'ID required' }

features.name: Alerts Management
features.description: Create, list, acknowledge, and delete KPI alerts; supports de-duplication and query filters.
user_flows: POST /api/alerts with body { type: 'roas_low', severity: 'high', title: 'ROAS rendah', message: 'ROAS < 2.0', metric: 'roas', threshold: '2.0' } -> Receive 200 Alert (created)
POST /api/alerts with body [ {...}, {...} ] (bulk) -> Receive 200 array of created Alert objects
GET /api/alerts?acknowledged=false&limit=50 -> Receive 200 array of Alert objects (filtered and limited)
DELETE /api/alerts?id=alert-id -> Receive 200 { success: true }
DELETE /api/alerts -> Receive 400 with { error: 'Need id or olderThanHours' }

features.name: App Settings
features.description: Get and update singleton application settings for AI priority, thresholds, and auto-sync configuration.
user_flows: GET /api/db/settings -> Receive 200 AppSettings (auto-created if missing)

POST /api/db/settings with body { defaultSheetId: '1Bxi...', aiPriority: 'kimi,claude,gemini', autoSyncEnabled: true, autoSyncInterval: 30, alertRoasLow: 2.0, alertRoasHigh: 4.0, alertCaqHigh: 200000, alertCrLow: 10.0, alertReturRateHigh: 5.0 } -> Receive 200 AppSettings updated
POST /api/db/settings with invalid values -> Receive 400 or 500 depending on validation (server error if update fails)

features.name: AI Chat Assistant
features.description: Multi-provider chat assistant for business Q&A and structured morning briefings with injected context and provider fallback.
user_flows: POST /api/chat with body { messages: [ { role: 'user', content: 'Bagaimana performa ROAS bulan ini?' } ], task: 'chat', context: { bulan: 'Mei 2026', kpi: { roas: 3.2 }, topAlerts: [] } } -> Receive 200 { message: '...', provider: 'kimi', task: 'chat' }
POST /api/chat with body { messages: [] , task: 'chat' } -> Receive 400 with { error: 'messages array is required' }
POST /api/chat with valid messages but all providers fail -> Receive 503 with list of provider errors

features.name: Retur (Return) Data Management
features.description: CRUD operations for product return records with optional filters by status, product, and month.
user_flows: POST /api/db/retur with body { date: '2026-05-04', produk: 'Produk A', cs: 'CS1', adv: 'Adv1', jumlah: 5, nilai: 1000000, alasan: 'Cacat', status: 'open' } -> Receive 200 ReturData (created or updated if id present)
GET /api/db/retur?status=open&produk=Produk%20A&month=2026-05 -> Receive 200 array of ReturData filtered
DELETE /api/db/retur?id=retur-id -> Receive 200 { success: true }
DELETE /api/db/retur -> Receive 400 with { error: 'ID required' }

features.name: Retur CSV Upload
features.description: Bulk import retur records via CSV upload (multipart/form-data).
user_flows: POST /api/db/retur/upload with multipart/form-data file field (.csv) -> Receive 200 { success: true, imported: 120, sample: [ ReturData, ... ] }
POST /api/db/retur/upload with invalid file or empty CSV -> Receive 400 with 'Invalid file or empty CSV'
POST /api/db/retur/upload with valid CSV but server parse error -> Receive 500 with parse or insert error message

features.name: Database Export
features.description: Download the current SQLite database file as a binary .db backup.
user_flows: GET /api/db/export -> Receive 200 binary .db file attachment with appropriate Content-Disposition
GET /api/db/export when DB not found -> Receive 500 with { error: 'Database file not found' }

features.name: Database Import/Restore
features.description: Restore/replace the current SQLite database from an uploaded .db file with an automatic backup created before restore.
user_flows: POST /api/db/import with multipart/form-data file field (.db) -> Receive 200 { success: true, message: 'Database restored', backup: 'backup-filename.db' }
POST /api/db/import with non-.db file -> Receive 400 with { error: 'Invalid file. Please upload a .db file.' }
POST /api/db/import with .db file but restore fails -> Receive 500 with restore failure message

tech_stack.other: Google Generative AI, Kimi (Moonshot), Anthropic Claude API, Chart.js, PapaParse, TailwindCSS

known_limitations.issue: No authentication or authorization on any API endpoint
known_limitations.impact: All endpoints are publicly accessible without any auth check

known_limitations.issue: Database import replaces entire database without schema validation
known_limitations.impact: Uploading an incompatible .db file could corrupt the application state

known_limitations.issue: No input validation on most POST endpoints (e.g., bookmarks, meetings, retur)
known_limitations.impact: Missing or malformed fields may cause Prisma errors instead of clean 400 responses

known_limitations.issue: Sheet proxy forwards arbitrary URLs without whitelist validation
known_limitations.impact: Potential SSRF — any internal or external URL can be fetched

known_limitations.issue: Alert limit query param parsed with parseInt without validation
known_limitations.impact: Non-numeric limit values result in NaN being passed to Prisma take parameter
